messages:
mira: Heads-up: StellarHealth asked for a tight pilot of Optimize toolkit: per-route quant fallback, adaptive batching presets, prefix/KV caching, and eval-triggered alerts. They want strict GA gates.

jordan: Sounds doable. What are their perf/quality targets?

mira: p95 <= 120ms for short chat flows, and quality drop <= 3% on their health eval set. Alert when concordance drops >5 pts over 1k requests.

andrew: On hosted we need conservative batching (batch<=4) + cache hit to hit 120ms. Dedicated can meet it easier. Per-route quant fallback -> quant by default, fallback to FP16 on eval regression.

sasha: We must avoid flapping. Propose hysteresis: require 2 consecutive windows before auto-fallback, and expose a route flag to opt-out.

mira: Pilot scope (keep small): adaptive batching presets, prefix/KV caching, per-route quant with manual canary + eval-triggered auto-fallback w/ hysteresis, and alert webhook. No kernel or compile work.

jordan: Config sketch:
```yaml
route: /stella/chat
quant_profile: r4-24q
quant_fallback: auto
batching: preset: mobile_small
cache: prefix: enabled, size_mb: 512
eval_alerts: threshold_pts: 5, window: 1000, webhook: https://hooks.stellar/alerts
```

andrew: Acceptance criteria draft: perf p95 <=120ms on 90% of pilot routes (24h windows); quality drop <=3% vs FP16; webhook within 5m of window close; cost per-route visible.

sasha: Ops constraints: default 5GB KV cache per tenant, LRU eviction; increases need infra/sales review. Also warn about cache warm-up impact.

mira: Mitigations: hysteresis, onboarding note showing warm-up curve, and a simple cost simulator for pilot routes.

andrew: Timeline: 2-week sprint for flags + alerting + demo, then 1-week pilot run.

jordan: Action: Ill draft SDK/route-flag spec and a tiny e2e test to simulate degradation->fallback. ETA EOD Friday.

sasha: Ill post cache quota + eviction proposal to #eng-infra tomorrow.

mira: ops-bot create pilot tracker with tags optimize-pilot and stellarhealth

ops-bot: Created ticket TID-9876: "optimize-pilot/stellarhealth"  assignees: mira, jordan, sasha, andrew.

mira: Thanks — quick sync tomorrow 10am to review PRs and tracker. :thumbsup
